name: mentat
description: Mentat's own marketplace: the core plugin and its opt-in modules, served from its repository.

plugins.name: mentat
plugins.description: Workflow rules, skills and hooks for Claude Code on GitHub repositories: a repository's maintainer requests a change, Claude Code proposes a plan and has a builder make it once the maintainer agrees, a fresh-context Claude reviews pull requests, joined by Codex and Grok where the reviewers module is on, and the maintainer merges.

plugins.name: mentat-reviewers
plugins.description: Mentat module: turned on in a repository's committed settings, it adds Codex to every review round and Grok's reviews (mentat review --codex, --grok), plus the outside-model second opinion (mentat second-opinion).

plugins.name: mentat-linear
plugins.description: Mentat module: the Linear backlog adapter, for a repository whose AGENTS.md names a Linear project.

plugins.name: mentat-extras
plugins.description: Mentat module, empty for now: will hold the grill and retro skills.

plugins.name: mentat-public-text
plugins.description: Mentat module: blocks GitHub text an agent is about to publish when it holds a word from ~/.config/mentat/private-words or a local home path.
